title: Studio Ping Pong
description: Studio Ping Pong hide their whole navigation behind a single paddle icon in the corner. Tap it and the page flips to a cream full-screen menu with four giant condensed links, each with its own little italic tagline. Big type, no clutter, lots of personality.

title: The Design Society
description: The Design Society is a community of designers in Lyon, and their navbar is a tiny floating window with a hamburger. Click it and it unfolds into a full retro OS dialog, complete with a pixel-art eye and scanlines. Lo-fi, playful and completely on brand.

title: L'Étude
description: L'Étude ditches the usual top bar for a vertical navbar centred down the middle of the page, doubling as both navigation and a work filter. Unique, minimal and very confident.

title: East Asian Graphics Archive
description:
Founded in 2023, the East Asian Graphics Archive (EAGA) is an archive of contemporary graphic design made by creatives, studios, and brands from across East Asia and the diaspora.

Using community-based archival methods that challenge the Western notion of archive as institution, the EAGA aims to preserve the richness of East Asian visual cultures and heritages through curation. In doing so, the Archive strives to interrogate and celebrate the intertwined legacies of the region’s design landscapes, while cultivating a broader appreciation of trailblazing graphic, typographical, and artistic practices from across East Asia.

title: Paradigm AI
description: Launch thousands of AI research agents in minutes

title: Stripe dot dev
description: Stripe.dev had no reason to go this hard. The site itself is wild but the navbar mirroring a TUI menu is genius.

title: Anima
description:
Anima co-found nature-inspired ventures to scale the ecological and economic impact of biomimicry.

Their entire website is a piece of art but their navbar is super unique!

title: Cho Choi Creative
description: Founded in late 2020 in Vietnam, ChoChoi is a team of passionate storytellers. They deliver high-impact brand experiences through strategic branding, innovative design, and data-driven social media marketing.

title: Naked City Films
description: A New York director led, production company.Built forcollaboration and partnership.

title: Adrien Lamy
description: Adrien Lamy is a Creative Dev Mercenary Based in Paris (the french one).

title: Beehiiv
description: The all-in-one platform that brings together newsletters, websites, and every growth tool you need to scale quickly and earn more.

title: Factory
description: A clean & minimal monotype navbar with a large dropdown.

title: Velvetyne
description: They don't come straighter to the point than the Velvetyne navbar. The entire navigation is laid out in the upper 20% of the hero section, and then collaposes into a more minimal version when scrolling.

title: Fonts Ninja
description: Fonts Ninja has a minimal sticky navbar by default but a super nice animated hidden navbar with some extra options!

title: ANUC HOME
description: ANUC's sticky navbar slides down the screen as you scroll as if locked onto some rails, as if it's confined to the grids that run throughout the website.

title: Cain
description: Cain's navbar is a minimal one that hides a neat trick to it, it animates as you scroll, highlighting the current section as it goes.

title: Greptile
description: Greptile's sticky, minimal mega-menu is a crash course in how to give your users everything you need in a small and compact navbar.

title: Shopify Supply
description: Shopify came out of nowhere earlier in 2025 with a random 3D augmented merch store, which also came with a nice full width mega menu!

title: Bruno Simon
description: Ok so this technically isn't a navbar, BUT, Bruno has made his entire website a 3D explorable navigation system, that you navigate via a 3D RC car. No, seriously.

title: Floor796
description: Floor796 is an insane website, but we're not here for that, we're here for the navbar. Floor796's navbar is taken straight from a Linux OS and gives the user the feeling of exploring this world inside their own computer.

title: Lando Norris
description: Lando Norris's website took the internet by storm when it launched, mainly due to the amazing hover and cursor effects seen in the hero section, but the full screen navbar is also a work of art.

title: American Haiku
description: American Haiku is a creative studio from NY who not only deliver insane projects but also turned their website into an experience of it's own. The site has both a static navbar that mimics a camcorder UI aswell as a sidedrawer that looks equally unique and vintage.

title: YUN GAO
description: An extremely unique website needs an extremely unique navbar and thats what Yun Gao brings. A simple and cute illustrated navbar with 3 simple options that sticks to your screen like a piece of chewing gum.

title: Edoardo Lunardi
description: Edo is an award winning Senior Frontend Developer with nearly a decade of experience. His personal website brings vintage CRT aesthetics with a navbar that looks like it was pulled straight from a terminal.

title: LAFOUR
description: LAFOUR wins the award for the most minimal navbar on the internet. The main attraction on the LAFOUR website is the striking videography looping in the background so understandbly the navbar takes a backseat, but still gives you all you need.

title: Dub Co
description: Dub's mega menu is a treat for your eyeballs, with smooth item transitions and soft rounded edges, this is a masterclass is mega menu UX.

title: Nektar
description: The Nektar navbar is a slim, understated bar that feels more like an editorial masthead than a typical website menu, using generous negative space and small, precise typography to keep the focus on the work.

title: Hackton AI
description: Hacktrons navbar is a minimal, high-contrast strip that keeps navigation and CTAs fixed at the top, pairing a simple wordmark with clear text links and bold primary buttons.

title: Scout AI
description: Scouts navbar is a clean, defense-grade strip that frames the Scout AI wordmark with simple text links on the left and a clear contact call-to-action on the right.
